items.name: Home dinner: Weis New York strip steak and avocado-cucumber salad with Bolthouse blue cheese

components.name: New York strip steak, whole, cooked lean and fat
components.portion: Approximately 11 oz cooked (312 g); plausible photo range 8-12 oz, not raw package/menu weight
components.note: USDA Choice top loin, separable lean and fat, trimmed to 1/8 inch, cooked grilled: 278 kcal, 26.16 g protein, 18.45 g fat per 100 g. Rounded high-side portion estimate, not a measured weight; cut and grade provisional.

components.name: Avocado
components.portion: User-confirmed 1/3 medium avocado; approximately 50 g edible (estimated mass)
components.note: Latest user correction confirms ONE THIRD, replacing the provisional half. Existing generic 75 g avocado nutrient estimate scaled by 2/3 to 50 g; edible mass remains estimated, not weighed.

components.name: Lettuce and cucumber salad vegetables
components.portion: Approximately 2 cups lettuce and 1/2-1 cup cucumber; small visible mixed-vegetable bits included in allowance
components.note: Approximate vegetable allowance; no inferred cheese, croutons, meat, or other calorie-dense toppings.

components.name: Bolthouse Farms Chunky Blue Cheese dressing
components.portion: 4 tbsp (60 g), upper end of approximate 3-4 tbsp visible dressing
components.note: Current official panel: 2 tbsp (30 g) = 50 kcal, 2 g protein, 4 g fat, 2 g carbs. Chunky Blue Cheese yogurt-based version used provisionally; exact bottle not inspected. Not regular high-fat blue cheese dressing.

components.name: Butter — 1 pat, assumed 5 g
components.portion: User-confirmed one pat finishing butter; assumed 5 g, all consumed
components.note: Reused existing USDA salted-butter proxy (SR Legacy 173410); brand and salted/unsalted unknown. This is the only added cooking/finishing fat allowance, not an extra pat stacked on another allowance. Original dinner counted no added cooking fat.

items.note: November 12 home meal from Weis, NOT a restaurant. User ate the whole steak and whole salad; thinks steak was New York strip but does not know weight. Four food photos inspected natively. Credible high-side estimate: about 11 oz COOKED steak, user-confirmed one-third medium avocado (~50 g edible estimated), and one pat finishing butter (~5 g estimated), lettuce/cucumber and 4 tbsp Bolthouse dressing. Approximate whole-meal range 850-1300 kcal, not a confidence interval; steak thickness, edible fat and portion dominate uncertainty. Latest user confirmation: ONE THIRD avocado and ONE PAT butter. Butter is counted once as the sole added-fat allowance; USDA lean-plus-fat steak already includes intrinsic fat. No additional oil or butter assumed. No inferred drinks or sides. Manufacturer nutrition verified; portions and exact dressing variant remain provisional.
